activity_summary: Near midnight a third candle had gone to the socket. You walked because lying made the gum worse, and you wrote nothing. You knew she would count the candles, and you knew the count would not be the girl.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Walked through three candles with the tooth, and wrote nothing.

entities.name: tallow candles
entities.context: Mentioned in The third candle at the socket

facets.activity: Walked the chamber through three candles

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: That is the third candle down to the socket since supper, and not a word written on the board.

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: The lovers were not the reason. The tooth was.
